segments.contextBefore: When designing your app or game, think of the Action button as another way for someone to quickly access a function that they use on a regular basis.
segments.contextAfter: **Support the Action button with a set of your app’s essential functions.** For example, if your cooking app includes an egg timer, a “Start Egg Timer” action might be one that people want to initiate when they press the Action button.

segments.source: **Support the Action button with a set of your app’s essential functions.** For example, if your cooking app includes an egg timer, a “Start Egg Timer” action might be one that people want to initiate when they press the Action button.
